control_note: removing a tenth of any universe changes its size mix, its sector mix and its concentration. `screened_minus_random` is the only column that is about the signals rather than about removing a tenth of a universe.
why_this_shape: six survivors carry their whole effect in decile 1 and a long top-k book lives in decile 10; the long-short that CAN reach decile 1 dies at 25bps or a 500bps borrow. An exclusion needs no borrow and no concentration.
